About this home

Welcome to 36-10 31 Street Apartment – Unit 3A

Click here to apply

Welcome to Unit 3A at Urban36, a stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence offering contemporary comfort in one of Queens’ most convenient neighborhoods. Located in Dutch Kills, between Long Island City and Astoria, this home combines modern interiors with easy access to Manhattan and the best of western Queens.

Whether you’re heading into Manhattan, enjoying an evening in Astoria, or relaxing at home with city views from the rooftop, Unit 3A at Urban36 offers a fresh, modern take on Queens living.

Make Urban36 your next home and experience comfort, convenience, and contemporary style in Dutch Kills.

💵 Rent & Income Eligibility Guidelines:

  • Note: Income limits depend on household size and are set according to area median income (AMI) guidelines.
  • Rent amount is subject to increase based on DHCR rent increase guidelines
  • Note: The minimum income does not apply to voucher holder applicants

Three Simple Steps To Enter An Affordable Apartment Lottery

01

Determine Your Eligibility

An applicant’s eligibility is determined according to his/her annual income and household size. The allowed annual income range varies per the specifications for each project. Use our handy eligibility checker tool.

02

Create Housing Connect Account

The Affordable Marketing lotteries or conducted by the New York City Housing Preservation Development (HPD). create an account with HPD’s “Housing Connect” website to enter a lottery.

03

Apply Through Housing Connect

Once your account is set up with Housing Connect you can easily apply to your desired apartment.
